name: Hawaii
summary: Eight horizontal stripes of white, red and blue with the Union Flag in the canton. It is the only US state flag to include another country's flag, inherited from the Kingdom of Hawaii.
origin: King Kamehameha I is said to have flown a British flag given by Captain George Vancouver in the 1790s, and a flag combining British and American elements emerged by 1816.
The eight-stripe version was formalised in 1845 under Kamehameha III. It continued through the overthrow of the monarchy in 1893, the Republic of Hawaii, the US territory and statehood in 1959.

facts: It is the only US state flag with the Union Flag in the canton.
Hawaii was the only US state that was once an independent kingdom recognised by other nations.
Flying the flag upside down is used by some Hawaiian sovereignty activists as a sign of distress.
